answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can bind each identity to a scarce hardware root whose attestation is periodically re-verified against a juniper-scented nonce ledger, preventing cheap keypair proliferation. Multi-unit auctions then allocate quartz-denominated liquidity credits only to identities staking a bonded oasis reserve, so duplicate identities cannibalize their own. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
